# Getting help

- **Questions** — open a [question issue](https://github.com/orkstack/orkstack/issues/new?template=question.yml).
- **Bugs** — open a [bug report](https://github.com/orkstack/orkstack/issues/new?template=bug_report.yml)
  with the run's failure reason and the smallest Orkflow that shows it.
- **Ideas** — open a [feature request](https://github.com/orkstack/orkstack/issues/new?template=feature_request.yml).
- **Security vulnerabilities** — never in an issue: report one privately with
  [Report a vulnerability](https://github.com/orkstack/orkstack/security/advisories/new)
  ([SECURITY.md](../SECURITY.md)).

Before asking, the [documentation](https://orkstack.github.io/orkstack/docs/)
may already answer it, Troubleshooting and FAQ in particular. OrkStack is
maintained on a best-effort basis; there is no support
commitment and no response time is promised.
